usage: arb-engine fees [-h] --venue VENUE --price PRICE [--contracts CONTRACTS]
                       [--role {taker,maker}] [--gold] [--exchange EXCHANGE]
                       [--multiplier MULTIPLIER] [--maker-fees] [--rounding {cent,centicent}]
                       [--rate RATE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --venue VENUE
  --price PRICE
  --contracts CONTRACTS
  --role {taker,maker}
  --gold
  --exchange EXCHANGE
  --multiplier MULTIPLIER
  --maker-fees          series charges maker fees (game markets do)
  --rounding {cent,centicent}
  --rate RATE           polymarket feeSchedule rate override
